Messages.Author: J Bond
Messages.Body:

For example, if i bums rush, and stealth it, can the vampire being
rushed, obedience instead of getting beat down?

Yes, the Obedience can be played, assuming the rushed vampire can play reaction
cards (is untapped or played Wake/FA).
